name: Soybean Crush Spread Dashboard
description: Research dashboard analyzing the soybean crush spread (gross processing margin). Loads ZS (Soybeans) as primary asset, ZM (Soybean Meal) and ZL (Soybean Oil) via reference_futures, all with NoAdjustment continuation. Computes GPM per bushel, oil/meal value shares, and cumulative averages. Outputs: summary table with current vs 3yr avg vs deviation; GPM line chart with cumulative mean overlay; component value chart (meal, oil, soy cost in $/bu); value share chart (oil% vs meal%) with reference lines; pie chart of current oil/meal split.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN CRUSH SPREAD RESEARCH DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
#
# Computes the gross processing margin (GPM) from crushing soybeans into
# meal and oil. All three legs use NoAdjustment continuation to preserve
# real price levels for cross-commodity arithmetic.
#
# Conversion factors (standard board crush per bushel):
#   Meal: 47.5 lbs yield → ZM priced $/short ton (2000 lbs)
#         meal_value_per_bu = ZM_price * (47.5 / 2000)
#   Oil:  11 lbs yield → ZL priced cents/lb
#         oil_value_per_bu = ZL_price * 11 / 100
#   Soy:  ZS priced cents/bu
#         soy_cost_per_bu = ZS_price / 100
#   GPM = meal_value + oil_value - soy_cost  (all $/bu)
#
# Outputs: snapshot table, GPM line, component values, value shares, pie
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZS (Soybeans) via market_data_source + futures_continuation ---
src = market_data_source()()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zs_price = zs_cont.c

# --- Reference: ZM (Soybean Meal) via reference_futures + continuation ---
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_ref.o, zm_ref.h, zm_ref.l, zm_ref.c, zm_ref.v, zm_ref.oi, zm_ref.s)
zm_price = zm_cont.c

# --- Reference: ZL (Soybean Oil) via reference_futures + continuation ---
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_ref.o, zl_ref.h, zl_ref.l, zl_ref.c, zl_ref.v, zl_ref.oi, zl_ref.s)
zl_price = zl_cont.c

# --- Per-bushel values (all in $/bu) ---
meal_value_per_bu = zm_price * (47.5 / 2000)   # $/ton → $/bu via 47.5 lbs yield
oil_value_per_bu = zl_price * 11 / 100          # cents/lb → $/bu via 11 lbs yield
soy_cost_per_bu = zs_price / 100                # cents/bu → $/bu

# --- Gross Processing Margin ---
gpm = meal_value_per_bu + oil_value_per_bu - soy_cost_per_bu

# --- Value share (fraction 0–1) ---
total_product_value = meal_value_per_bu + oil_value_per_bu
oil_share = oil_value_per_bu / total_product_value
meal_share = meal_value_per_bu / total_product_value

# --- Cumulative averages (expanding mean over full study window) ---
avg_gpm = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(gpm)
avg_oil_share = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(oil_share)
avg_meal_share = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(meal_share)

# --- Deviations ---
gpm_dev = gpm - avg_gpm                         # absolute $/bu deviation
oil_share_dev = oil_share - avg_oil_share        # pp deviation
meal_share_dev = meal_share - avg_meal_share     # pp deviation

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — GPM, Oil Share, Meal Share
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean Crush Spread Snapshot',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['GPM ($/bu)', 'Oil Share', 'Meal Share'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Avg', 'Deviation'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current GPM', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Cumulative Avg GPM', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='GPM Deviation from Avg ($)', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Oil Share', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Avg Oil Share', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Oil Share Deviation (pp)', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Meal Share', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Avg Meal Share', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Meal Share Deviation (pp)', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(gpm, avg_gpm, gpm_dev, oil_share, avg_oil_share, oil_share_dev, meal_share, avg_meal_share, meal_share_dev)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: GPM over time with cumulative mean overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Gross Processing Margin ($/bu)',
    category='2. GPM',
    y_axis_label='GPM ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero Margin')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GPM', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Avg', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(gpm, avg_gpm))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Component values — meal, oil, soy cost (all $/bu)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Crush Components ($/bu)',
    category='3. Components',
    y_axis_label='$/bu',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Value', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Value', color=Color.Teal),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Cost', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(meal_value_per_bu, oil_value_per_bu, soy_cost_per_bu))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Oil & Meal value shares with avg reference lines
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Product Value Share (Oil vs Meal)',
    category='4. Value Share',
    y_axis_label='Share',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50/50 Split')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Share', color=Color.Teal),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Share', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(oil_share, meal_share))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Pie chart — current oil vs meal share
# pivot_longer stacks the two share series into (label, value) pairs;
# pie groups by label and normalizes to percentages.
# =============================================================================
shares_long = pivot_longer(names=['Oil', 'Meal'])((oil_share, meal_share))

pie(
    title='Current Oil / Meal Split',
    category='4. Value Share',
    inner_size=50,
    colors=[Color.Teal, Color.Blue],
    order=4
)(label=shares_long.label, value=shares_long.value)
